moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially began on Friday, August 21st, with reigning champions Arsenal facing Coventry City and other major fixtures across the opening weekend.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicked off yesterday, and the first results are in. Who's looking strong out of the gate?

angles.name: Local Team Focus
angles.copy: The new Premier League season is underway! How did your team perform on the opening weekend? Plenty to talk about already!

moments.title: Notting Hill Carnival Returns
moments.blurb: Europe's largest street festival, Notting Hill Carnival, is set to transform West London from Saturday 29 to Monday 31 August 2026, celebrating Caribbean culture with music, parades, and food.

angles.name: Carnival Countdown
angles.copy: Get ready, London! Notting Hill Carnival kicks off next weekend, bringing incredible music, vibrant parades, and a taste of Caribbean culture to the streets. Who's excited?

angles.name: Music & Culture
angles.copy: Steel bands, sound systems, and street food! Notting Hill Carnival is just days away. What are you most looking forward to experiencing?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Weekend
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival takes over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park from August 27-30, 2026, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festival is just around the corner! Who are you most excited to see? The lineup is stacked with Charli XCX, Florence + The Machine, Dave and more!

angles.name: Camping & Music
angles.copy: Getting your tents ready? Reading & Leeds is almost here! Four days of incredible live music and festival vibes await. What's your top tip for surviving the weekend?

moments.title: Shambala Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The independent and sustainable Shambala Festival runs from August 27-30, 2026, offering a unique 'Adventures in Utopia' experience with a diverse music and arts lineup.

angles.name: Alternative Festival
angles.copy: Shambala Festival kicks off next week! For those seeking something different, it's four days of music, arts, and sustainable living. Who's heading to 'Adventures in Utopia'?

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean hold the #1 spot on the Official UK Singles Chart this week with 'Rein Me In' for a remarkable 22nd week, while new tracks from Madonna & Kylie Minogue, and Phoebe Bridgers enter the chart.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still at #1! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' dominates the Official UK Singles Chart for a 22nd week. Huge! What's your favourite track in the Top 40?

angles.name: New Entries
angles.copy: New music alert on the Official Singles Chart! Madonna & Kylie Minogue with 'Love Sensation' and Phoebe Bridgers' 'Lost Weekend' are among the new entries. What are you listening to?

moments.title: The Voice UK Returns
moments.blurb: A brand new series of 'The Voice UK' premieres tonight, Saturday 22nd August, at 7pm on ITV1, bringing fresh talent and familiar coaching chairs back to screens.

angles.name: Saturday Night TV
angles.copy: Your Saturday night is sorted! The Voice UK is back for a new series tonight on ITV1 at 7pm. Who are you hoping to see turn a chair?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Dua Lipa
moments.blurb: Today, August 22nd, marks the 31st birthday of global pop superstar Dua Lipa, known for hits like 'New Rules' and 'Don't Start Now'.

angles.name: Pop Queen Birthday
angles.copy: Sending huge birthday wishes to the incredible Dua Lipa, who turns 31 today! What's your all-time favourite Dua track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Howie Dorough
moments.blurb: Howie Dorough of the iconic Backstreet Boys celebrates his 53rd birthday today, August 22nd.

angles.name: Backstreet Boy B-day
angles.copy: Happy 53rd Birthday to Backstreet Boys' very own Howie Dorough! What's your favourite BSB song to sing along to?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Tori Amos
moments.blurb: The influential singer-songwriter and pianist Tori Amos turns 63 today, August 22nd, known for her distinctive voice and powerful lyrics.

angles.name: Alt-Rock Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 63rd Birthday to the one and only Tori Amos! Her music has resonated with so many. What's your go-to Tori track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Roland Orzabal
moments.blurb: Roland Orzabal, co-founder of the iconic New Wave band Tears for Fears, celebrates his 65th birthday today, August 22nd.

angles.name: Tears for Fears Legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to Roland Orzabal of Tears for Fears! From 'Everybody Wants To Rule The World' to 'Shout', what's your favourite track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Julian Casablancas
moments.blurb: Tomorrow, August 23rd, Julian Casablancas, frontman of The Strokes and The Voidz, turns 48 years old.

angles.name: Indie Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Tomorrow, The Strokes' frontman Julian Casablancas turns 48! What's your favourite era of his music?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Shaun Ryder
moments.blurb: Shaun Ryder, the charismatic frontman of Happy Mondays and Black Grape, celebrates his 64th birthday tomorrow, August 23rd.

angles.name: Madchester Legend
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to the one and only Shaun Ryder tomorrow! Get your 'Step On' on and celebrate the Happy Mondays icon.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Elvis Costello
moments.blurb: Influential singer-songwriter Elvis Costello, known for hits like 'Oliver's Army' and 'Pump It Up', turns 72 on Monday, August 25th.

angles.name: Punk/New Wave Icon
angles.copy: On Monday, we celebrate the 72nd birthday of the legendary Elvis Costello! Which of his classics is your favourite?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Florence Welch
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the captivating voice of Florence + The Machine, will celebrate her 40th birthday on Thursday, August 28th.

angles.name: Birthday for Florence
angles.copy: The incredible Florence Welch turns 40 on Thursday! From 'Dog Days Are Over' to 'Shake It Out', what's your favourite Florence + The Machine anthem?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Shania Twain
moments.blurb: Country-pop icon Shania Twain, known for global hits like 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!' and 'That Don't Impress Me Much', turns 61 on Thursday, August 28th.

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the legendary Shania Twain this Thursday! What's your go-to Shania track for a singalong?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Liam Howlett
moments.blurb: Liam Howlett, the mastermind behind electronic music pioneers The Prodigy, celebrates his 55th birthday on Saturday, August 30th.

angles.name: Prodigy Producer
angles.copy: Get ready to 'Firestarter' on Saturday as Liam Howlett of The Prodigy turns 55! What's your favourite Prodigy anthem?

moments.title: Heather On The Hill Festival
moments.blurb: The new family festival 'Heather On The Hill', curated by Nathan Evans, is taking place today, Saturday 22nd August, in Edinburgh, featuring Cian Ducrot, Ella Henderson and more.

angles.name: Edinburgh Festival Fun
angles.copy: Edinburgh is buzzing today with the new 'Heather On The Hill' festival! Who's soaking up the live music from Cian Ducrot, Ella Henderson and more?
